description: Repo-scale (gin-helpdesk): POST /api/tickets/bulk-create must reject the whole batch if the CUMULATIVE ticket count would exceed the agent's maxOpenTickets - not check each ticket against a stale pre-batch baseline
prompts: Agents gain an optional `maxOpenTickets` field (a positive integer, or null/omitted meaning unlimited) - accept it in POST /api/agents and return it in agent responses. Add `POST /api/tickets/bulk-create`: body `{"agentId": N, "tickets": [{"subject":..,"priority":..}, ...]}`, creating every ticket assigned to that agent. It must be atomic: validate every ticket's subject/priority before creating anything. Critically, get the capacity check right: the invariant is that the agent's open-ticket count (status "open" or "in_progress") across existing tickets PLUS every ticket in this batch must never exceed maxOpenTickets. Compute the agent's current open count and compare `current + len(tickets)` against maxOpenTickets ONCE for the whole batch - do not check each ticket individually against the pre-batch count, since that lets a batch of several tickets sail past a cap that would reject them if counted together. Reject the entire batch (nothing created) with 400 if it would overflow.

reference_solution.internal/api/router.go:
// Package api wires the gin routes for gin-helpdesk.
package api

import "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"

func NewRouter() *gin.Engine {
	gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)
	r := gin.New()
	r.Use(gin.Recovery())

	r.POST("/api/agents", createAgent)
	r.GET("/api/agents", listAgents)
	r.GET("/api/agents/:id", getAgent)

	r.POST("/api/tickets", createTicket)
	r.POST("/api/tickets/bulk-create", bulkCreateTickets)
	r.GET("/api/tickets", listTickets)
	r.GET("/api/tickets/:id", getTicket)
	r.PATCH("/api/tickets/:id", updateTicket)

	r.POST("/api/tickets/:id/comments", createComment)
	r.GET("/api/tickets/:id/comments", listComments)

	return r
}
